name: Appier Enterprise MCP Server
description:
Connect Claude securely to Appier Enterprise products through the Model Context Protocol.
The connector helps marketing, data, and growth teams use Appier context directly within Claude. Teams can explore customer insights, understand campaign and journey performance, work with audiences and marketing content, and support cross-channel planning.
It integrates with Appier products including AIQUA and AIRIS, with additional Enterprise capabilities added incrementally. Available tools and actions depend on the products, permissions, and connector version enabled for your organization.
Authentication uses Appier OAuth, and access follows each user’s existing Appier project permissions. An eligible Appier Enterprise account is required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Appier Enterprise MCP Server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Appier Enterprise MCP Server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.enterprise.appier.net/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Appier Enterprise MCP Server MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appier Enterprise MCP Server lists 38 MCP tools, including analyze_user_data, count_customers, find_customer_events, find_customer_profiles, get_available_edm_templates_for_project, get_campaign, get_campaign_creatives, get_campaign_performance_by_channel, get_campaign_stats, get_campaign_variant_stats, get_email_template, and get_journey_node_performance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Appier Enterprise MCP Server?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Appier Enterprise MCP Server in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Appier Enterprise MCP Server MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appier Enterprise MCP Server requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Appier Enterprise MCP Server?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appier Enterprise MCP Server is developed by Appier Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
